# Hardware Control Channels

Q-PRISM may propose schedules only through lawful experimental controls.

## Allowed Channels

- optical grating phase,
- grating timing,
- laser power profile,
- velocity-bin selection,
- scan order,
- detector analysis window,
- decoherence-model parameter sweep.

## Disallowed Framing

Do not describe the prism stream as directly entering a quantum state.

The honest hardware sentence is:

> A prism-derived stream selected a control schedule, and the experiment measured whether that schedule improved interference metrics.

## First Hardware Milestone

The first hardware milestone is not a consciousness claim. It is:

> Blinded Q-PRISM schedules outperform random and classical schedules on predeclared visibility or phase-stability metrics.
